description: This file contains unit tests for the FrameMap class, specifically testing methods related to range queries of frames and entries within a call stack trace map. It uses the Jest testing framework and imports classes FrameMap and FrameMapBuilder.

classes.name: FrameMap
classes.description: Represents a mapping of frames within a trace, providing range queries for frames and entries.

classes.name: FrameMapBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing FrameMap instances with specified frames.

methods.name: getFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the range of frames covering the specified start and end positions.

methods.name: getEntriesRange
methods.description: Returns the range of entries covering the specified start and end positions.

methods.name: getFullTraceFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the range covering the entire trace.
